description: Manage quota checks, continuation rules and local Codex / ChatGPT Work target chats.

interface.shortDescription: 1.0 · Continue unfinished tasks after quota resets
interface.longDescription:
Configure quota thresholds, reset delays and exact continuation prompts in one panel. Open Manage Codex Task Resume from native plugin settings or the global app entry.

While the local plugin service is connected, read-only checks capture identified running work turns at low quota; selected idle chats are never queued. The panel distinguishes actual reset time, planned check, saved targets, candidates and schedule records. Settings and read-only quota queries do not call the model.

Initialize one controller, review the hooks and explicitly enable continuation. Before sending, verify recovered quota, elapsed delay, native task state and evidence of unfinished work. Skip running, completed, paused, blocked or ambiguous tasks.

A native recovery schedule must be established in advance. Without one before exhaustion, automatic wake is not guaranteed; later quota windows require correct rescheduling. A complete recovery cycle remains unverified. Scheduling, recovery and continued tasks use normal quota.

For Windows local execution only. The UI follows the system display language. Ordinary ChatGPT web, cloud tasks, remote hosts and subagents are unsupported. Client exit, service disconnection or sleep can delay execution.

Use the bundled installer or local-assistant installation prompt. Updates preserve user settings and runtime records. Author: 果果. Project: https://github.com/mango6i/codex-task-resume
